name: Skill scout
summary: Ask a running Claude session which catalog skills would have helped its work and add one with a tap.
description: Skill scout, in a session's session skills panel, pastes a short request into the running Claude agent. The request lists the skills of the signed catalog you have not installed (id, name, description; nothing unsigned) and a small digest of this conversation's own history: the skills it used most, the tools that keep failing and its last few corrections, with anything that looks like a credential dropped. It is refused, and nothing is pasted, when the pane is stopped on a question, dead or not an agent. The agent answers with lines of the form CARNIVORE-SKILL id | reason; the app reads them from the transcript and shows only ids that exist in the verified catalog, without duplicates and at most ten, each as a chip with the reason as plain text. A chip adds the skill to this project through the normal install path: one tap when the server allows it, the consent sheet otherwise; consent is never skipped.
where: In a Claude terminal, open the three-dot menu, choose session skills, and look for the skill scout block.
how_to: Press scout and wait for the agent to answer.
Press a chip to add that skill to this session's project; a consent sheet opens when the skill needs your say-so.
examples: An agent keeps failing on the same tool: scout suggests a catalog skill built for it.
media_exempt: the answer comes from a live agent reading a signed catalog, which no neutral demo seed can fake; shots are taken by hand at review
